programme.title: Animal ER

programme.title: Teksasin riistanvalvojat

programme.title: Life Below Zero
programme.desc: This eye-opening series follows the drama and hardships experienced by four Alaskan households in different corners of this merciless territory as they battle to make it through a long, dark, freezing winter. The huge US state of Alaska boasts some of the world's most deadly weather, with temperatures regularly plummeting to a lethal -80 Fahrenheit, freezing exposed limbs in minutes. Yet it is also home to some of the toughest, most resilient, most isolated people in the world. Life is all about survival in the face of unrelenting weather, scarce resources and man-eating carnivores.

programme.desc: David presents animal species whose seasonal (dis)appearing has puzzled men for centuries. First geese and other migratory birds, which were long supposed to 'hibernate' in bizarre ways, a matter of dispute centuries even after emperor-falconer Frederic Hohenstaufen wrote down the actual fact. Next butterflies, who were believed 'sponteously generated' until people realized they are the adult form of utterly dissimilar caterpillars.

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures deep into the Black Forest, where he discovers how Hansel and Gretel helped to unify the German nation. A masterclass in carving cuckoo clocks demonstrates how the nation's reputation for quality and reliability in manufacturing was established. Later, at Goettingen University, the former politician discovers two sides of student life at the turn of the 20th century - the duelling fraternities and the ground-breaking scientists who laid the foundation of Germany's world-class transport technology.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Natural Curiosities
programme.desc: The chameleon fascinated naturalists since the family's discovery, mainly on account of its color-shifting, while arousing various legends, even being a diabolic spy created from other animals. David focuses on another anatomical oddity, the extraordinarily long, fast-propelled tongue, aimed thanks to the two independently-controlled eyes combining to full circle-sight. Giraffes always fascinated humans, making them an ideal princely gift from the Egyptian viceroy for major European monarchs. Its entire anatomy is out of whack to accommodate for the exceptionally long neck and legs, presumably mainly to reach high leaves.

programme.desc: Robin (SCOTT MENVILLE), Starfire (HYNDEN WALCH), Cyborg (KHARY PAYTON), Beast Boy (GREG CIPES) and Raven (TARA STRONG) continue the fun in season six of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero … once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy — based upon DC characters — focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure — these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out. In the season seven premiere, Robin dreams of receiving a #1 Dad mug, so Raven magically turns them into a sitcom family.

But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: While they are enjoying the longest day of the summer, Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit realise that the forest is drying out. Worried, Mushpot explains to our friends that the Tree of Life, that regenerate the entire forest, is dying! There is only one Mushable who could help Mushpot to save the forest: Starmush. But the Mushelders haven’t gotten along for years. Will they be able to put their differences aside in order to save the Tree of Life before it’s too late?

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Chep has come across a new seedpod specimen. Mushpot warns him not to take it though. But the temptation is too much and Chep can’t resist taking the seedpod and opening it… to find it is full of itchy powder! Argh! Mush-Mush and Lilit do their best to help their friend, but it seems like the only way Chep can get rid of the itching is to ask Mushpot for a remedy…

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush can’t wait to show his tricks of forest illusion to everyone. But Amanita keeps ruining Mush-Mush’s performance by figuring out all his tricks. Grrr! When Mush-Mush decides to do his famous ‘Disappearing Mushable’ trick on Truff, Truff really disappears! And now, Amanita and Mush-Mush must join forces to find their disappearing friend.

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush is very proud he invented a new game called Fruity Bounce, where he and his friends bounce as high as possible on the bouncier fruits they can find.

programme.title: Tom And Jerry
programme.desc: One cat's delicacy is another mouse's poison. Tom And Jerry gets caught in a thorny issue over the aroma of durian. Will they reconcile their differences over the King of Fruits?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: When the Lemmings activate the air conditioner's AI, it falls in love with the fridge.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a polar bear fallen off a zoo's truck and realizes they're from the same species.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings’ hard rock concert is driving Grizzy mad. After kicking them out, Grizzy requisitions their ghetto blaster and listens to a relaxation cassette to calm down. The Lemmings discover an ancestral tree whose engraved strips of bark cast targeted maledictions. To recover their material, the Lemmings decide to drive Grizzy out by cursing him with the Ten Plaques of the Savanna.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys himself a DIY remote-controlled boat kit so he can compete in a race on the local pond. But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are at the cinema to see the three hour long “Romance In Paris”, which Mr Bean is not looking forward to. But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie – Zombie Aliens 3 – he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: When a TV show offers cash to film in haunted homes, Mr Bean invites a film crew over and rigs his flat up to make it as spooky as possible – wobbly picture frames on wires, eerie noises on a tape recorder and a good old-fashioned sheet for a ghost. But will the tricks be convincing enough to win Mr Bean the money?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a magician's hat that tosses out objects stored inside beforehand with the tap of a magic wand. He decides to impress his beloved she-bear with a magician's act.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

And he does not intend to share it with the Lemmings. After observing a chameleon toad that is able to blend into its surroundings, the Lemmings decide to make themselves invisible to attain Grizzy's treasure.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: A magic tomahawk divides Grizzy into two identical bears with diametrically opposite personalities: one short-tempered, the other super-sweet. The Lemmings, who did not witness Grizzy's split, will have a hard time working out the behavior of their usual enemy, who seems to swing from excessive kindness to the worst trickery for no reason.

However, their irascible neighbor, Baby Beaver, diverts the convoy so that the ants start transporting his sticks for him instead. When Baby Castor loses control of the ants and finds himself in trouble, the Baby Lemmings come to the rescue with an even more fun game!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: The baby lemmings are having a picnic but have a nasty tendency to get raspberry juice all over themselves. When one of the baby lemmings dirties baby Raccoon, who has just finished washing up, baby Raccoon decides to take matters into his own hands and wash them. But the baby lemmings get dirty immediately! Baby Raccoon decides to teach them some manners!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Baby Chipmunk is trying to carry a ton of nuts back to her den, but climbing down the cliff with all her nuts is proving a complex task. As for the baby lemmings, they've discovered the principle of the slide and are having fun building a longer and longer one. When the baby chipmunk sees this, she sees a great opportunity to get her nuts down more cheaply.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Jerry sneaks into the party set up to steal some cheese while Tom is sleeping. Tom wakes up and chases Jerry across a table filled with all kinds of food. During the chase, Tom eats a melon which turns him into a sphere shape and Jerry eats a piece of cheese which turns him into a triangle shape.

programme.title: Batwheels

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: When Redbird takes one of Buff's stuffed animals without asking and it accidentally gets swiped by the Legion of Zoom, Red enlists Bam to help him make a daring rescue.

programme.title: Take 10
programme.desc: While Gwen listens to a lecture on the Transcontinental Railroad, Ben sneaks away to the gift shop, but once the Bounty Hunters appear and corner our hero, Gwen must relay the information she learned on the train and use it to their advantage to help Ben escape.

programme.title: Take 10
programme.desc: As Max attempts to get Ben and Gwen to the Four Corners Monument before sunset, an ominous fog bank engulfs the roadway and forces Max to drive at a snail's pace, but once The Fogg comes to life and attacks the Rust Bucket, Team Tennyson must work together if they are to navigate to safety.

programme.title: Take 10
programme.desc: Ben suggests he might be a better hero if he went solo.

programme.title: Take 10
programme.desc: After stumbling upon a cute cat-dog-rabbit creature hybrid, or 'Cadobbit,' Ben ignores Grandpa Max's advice and sneaks the animal onto the Rust Bucket. / During the Biggie Box sale, Ben enlists Simon Sez to help him find Max and get back to the register with his toys before the sale ends and Billy Billions buys them instead. / Aboard the SS Pettigrew on its final voyage, Ben must not only battle seasickness but Steam Smythe, who looks to use his mechanical creatures to sink the steamship's replacement. / After their attempt to get a photo with every storefront mascot is foiled, Ben and Gwen sneak out at night to get their photo taken with the wooden bear totem known as 'Yawk'. / When a cavity forces Ben to the dentist his day gets even worse when the malevolent magician Hex uses a nearby dream catcher to bring our hero's fears to life.

programme.title: Take 10
programme.desc: When Ben and Max get into an argument, Ben goes Heatblast to blow off steam against Max's wishes.

programme.title: Take 10
programme.desc: When Ben grows impatient with the snail-like pace of gardening, he goes O-E Overflow to pick up the pace and accidentally floods the community garden.

programme.title: Take 10
programme.desc: Ben and Gwen face King Koil at Repto Ranch.

programme.title: Take 10
programme.desc: When Gwen is confronted by Charmcaster looking to avenge Michael Morningstar, Gwen must prove to herself she's a worthy member of Team Tennyson.

programme.title: Take 10
programme.desc: While bird watching at Pinnacles National Park, Gwen and Ben get into a competition of who can spot more birds first, but once a forrest fire interrupts their fun, Team Tennyson must hurry if they are to save the bird population and discover who is behind the suspiciously growing fire: Hex!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is unimpressed with a horror movie he sees at the cinema and reckons he can do much better. Bean sets out to create his very own home movie masterpiece –featuring Mrs Wicket Irma and Teddy! The screening in the garden is a huge success but will Mrs Wicket be pleased with her makeover and starring role?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr. Bean has to look after Mrs. Wicket's goldfish, but he also deals with Scrapper, who wants to eat the goldfish alive. After several attempts of transferring the fishbowl, Bean cages Scrapper but accidentally drops it in the toilet bowl and flushes it down to the sewer. Bean manages to retrieve it, but it jumps to a pond where a boy fishes it out.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean wins two tickets for an exotic cruise and naturally he takes Teddy along for the trip of a lifetime. Once aboard the huge ocean liner Mr Bean soon settles into a life of luxury but while showing off to a new friend Bean becomes ‘man overboard’ and stranded on a dessert island. The hungrier he gets the wilder he becomes and desperate to find a way off the island.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it. When he sees a poster for the local funfair where the stalls have cash prizes Bean is determined to win himself some money on the Coconut Shy. But after many unsuccessful attempts he realises it’s a fix and lets everyone know about it. Naturally this doesn’t go down well with the stallholder who wants revenge and a chase around the funfair ensues.

As the snow falls outside Mr Bean’s flat becomes so cold that there are ice cubes in his bath water. Mr Bean has the idea to build a huge wind turbine in the back garden providing his own power. All is going very well until an unexpected storm sends Bean’s wind turbine into overdrive creating a huge surge of electricity and a huge shock for everyone

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his local bakery to buy a cake but finds he doesn’t have any money. He goes to the bank to use the cash machine but he can’t remember his pin number. When Mr Bean's bankcard is swallowed up by the cash machine there’s only one thing to do - go into the machine and fetch it back. The police are alerted but Bean’s main concern is to get some money and get back to the baker’s before all the cakes are sold.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series

Armed with several bin bags Mr Bean collects all the rubbish and puts up his own ‘No Littering’ signs - which have absolutely no effect. When the police show no interest in his campaign Bean builds a homemade vacuuming contraption causing chaos and mayhem wherever he goes.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in need of a sturdy new bookcase and sets off to visit a furniture warehouse. He finds one that’s perfect but is outraged when he’s told he has to build the bookcase himself! Bean is unfamiliar with flat pack assembly and struggles to construct his new bookcase failing miserably when he discovers he’s one screw short. Mr Bean heads back to the shop only to find it’s closed!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to take Teddy on holiday to the seaside. But when he arrives at his hotel a spoilt little girl wants Teddy all for herself. And her protective dad only wants the best for his ‘princess’. An on-going tussle ensues between Mr Bean the little girl and her Dad resulting in a chase across the seaside town and onto the pier. No one comes between Mr Bean Teddy and their ‘relaxing’ holiday!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is left in peace when Mrs Wicket goes off on her holidays. This means Mr Bean has free access to her daily newspaper. Every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it has disappeared. Someone is taking it, but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!

programme.title: Batwheels

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: When the Legion of Zoom plan to cheat their way to winning the Gotham Grand Prix, the Batwheels zoom into action to ensure the race is won the right way - fair and square !

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: With their endless battles over the ranger's cabin which they do not want to share, Grizzy and the Lemmings end up blowing the cabin up. Amidst the debris, they discover a strange pack: an army tent with all the necessary equipment to recreate a home in nature. It's the chance to discover the joys of camping in the wild.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

The bear makes a fabulous rodeo partner, he just needs enough ice to keep cool. Even a few ice cubes on his head are enough. The only obstacle to this beautiful friendship is Grizzy, who considers himself master of the fridge and thus of the cabin's ice production.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy gets rid of the Lemmings by crushing them with one of the ranger’s heavy trunks, which he immediately clears out of the cabin, with his enemies stuck to it like stickers.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a strange pond in an American Indian grotto that has the power to rejuvenate anyone who dips in it. They spray a bit of the water of youth onto Grizzy and he instantly turns into a harmless cub they can easily rid themselves of. But the effects of the waters are only temporary.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger¿s house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this bear's privilegeexcept the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings happen on a native American Indian burial place under the ranger's cabin. When they accidentally activate a magic disk representing the earth, they are sent back in time to the prehistoric era...

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean embarks on plenty of adventures, along with his sidekick, Teddy. They try to stay out of the way of Mrs Wicket and her cat Scrapper, but often end up in trouble.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is bored of queuing for a trampoline park, so secretly bounces in through a window using a trampette. But he soon gets on the wrong side of a young show-off boy who keeps stealing Teddy and throwing him in hard-to-reach spots. To settle their row, they agree on a race around the trampoline park – first place wins Teddy. Will Mr Bean triumph before he’s chucked out for jumping the queue?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma is struggling to sell items from her knitwear stall at the market, so sends Mr Bean to collect a sheep costume he can wear to attract customers. Once at the fancy dress shop however, Mr Bean gets stuck in the sheep costume and has to travel back to the market wearing it. Things go from bad to worse when Mr Bean takes a short cut across the field and gets caught up in a flock of real sheep!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings meet a spider and his web, which allows them to play like baby Spider-Man. They even develop a tree climbing course in the forest. Baby Beaver, for his part, has a hard time fitting branches together to build a bridge over the river. When he sees the construction possibilities offered by the lemmings' spider, he decides to steal it from them.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

Grizzy realizes that he could make the gorgeous butterfly on the cover for his beloved she-bear. But to make the Lemmings bow to his authority, he will first have to become a true origami master.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings are all lined up on the couch to watch a cartoon film where a mouse plays nasty tricks on a cat. Grizzy, who has decided to take his nap, switches off the TV and confiscates the batteries of the remote control to make sure they can't switch their program back on. But is it wise to frustrate a gang of Lemmings who've been inspired by a gag-filled cartoon?

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Once again, Grizzy shows the Lemmings that they just don't measure up to him physically and that the last jar of chocolate spread is for the strongest. The Lemmings find a way around this by increasing the power of a lamp that accelerates plant growth and instantly expand themselves to... bear size.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay their hands on a full crate of chocolate spread, which they hide somewhere behind Grizzy's back. And since the Lemmings are both prudent and cunning, it's impossible to surprise them when they pay a visit to their secret hoard. Until the day Grizzy discovers a magic ring that enables him to take on the appearance of a Lemming.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front – but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are invited across the road for dinner, and Mr Paliwal is particularly keen to show off his brand-new white sofa. As Mr Bean tests it out, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions. Can Mr Bean clean the sofa before anyone notices?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some cash to take Scrapper to the pet groomer’s, he can’t believe the cost! Instead he buys a basic grooming kit, pockets the rest of the cash and gives the cat a makeover himself, without Mrs Wicket realising. Spotting a business opportunity, Mr Bean then sets himself up as a pet groomer in the back garden. But Mrs Wicket discovers she’s been tricked and now she wants revenge!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean embarks on plenty of adventures, along with his sidekick, Teddy. They try to stay out of the way of Mrs Wicket and her cat Scrapper, but often end up in trouble.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: When MOE creates a new, super sparkly vehicle paint, the Batwheels decide to put on a talent show to see who will get a shiny new makeover! / Redbird struggles to stop Poison Ivy's diabolical schemes because he wants to be in the spotlight. / Redbird gets excited when he learns that Batman and Robin are taking him and Bam for a drive up the coast! / Redbird sacrifices his muffler to sound louder.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: The Batwheels take on a new vehicular villain who keeps growing bigger and bigger, while learning that size doesn't always win the day.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: While Green Lantern is having his spaceship repaired in the Batcave, the Batwheels want to play with his adorable alien pet, only to discover that this cute critter has wild alien powers!

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: When Poison Ivy uses a rare pollen-spewing flower to put all of Gotham to sleep, it's up to Bibi to save her friends and save the day. / Super-genius villain Egghead is on the loose, planning to use Gotham Museum’s famed giant egg to cook up a record-breaking breakfast.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: When Badcomputer activates his own satellite and takes control of every computer on Earth, the Batwheels must launch into space to stop him! / The Batwheels soar through space in their Bat-Rocket and have to navigate all sorts of orbiting obstacles to reach Badcomputer’s satellite.

programme.title: Batwheels
programme.desc: When Badcomputer activates his own satellite and takes control of every computer on Earth, the Batwheels must launch into space to stop him! / When the Batwheels celebrate their mutual birthdays together in the park, party games that should be fun start to go mysteriously wrong.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock – Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: When Mushpie gets sick, our Mushlers find it impossible to believe that she turns into the most demanding Mushable ever. Well, they're about to find out that it's all true!

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Fung finds out that to earn a delicious treat from Sushi-Mushi you just need to look after the Food Snail for him. No problem! Actually, it becomes a huge problem for Fung!

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: When Mushpot is too tired to give anyone advice, he asks Mush-Mush to answer the Mushables' requests on his behalf. But now Mush-Mush thinks he is the leader of Mushton!

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: When Chep thinks he has remembered that he is younger than his two best friends, Mush-Mush and Lilit, it affects his whole confidence

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit are ecstatic: Muddler’s fear of spiders rid the forest of him! But they soon learn that even Muddler is essential to the health of the forest.

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Lilit looks up to Chanterelle as an awesome role model. She would so love to be like her one day. But when she starts imitating Chanterelle it doesn’t go to plan.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings find an ice block outside the log cabin that holds a frozen prehistoric animal: a saber-toothed racoon. Softened, the Lemmings free the creature and try to tame it like a kitten. But the raccoon is like a whirlwind. Grizzy wakes up and discovers the cabin topsy-turvy and flies into a rage. But when the bear tries to kick the rodents out, the wild raccoon challenges him.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger¿s house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this bear's privilegeexcept the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: In a trunk, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a big chocolate egg with a surprise inside. They are licking their lips. As they fight, they accidentally send the coveted egg flying amidst a group of penguins where a couple of winged creatures adopt it. They sit on the egg as if it were their offspring. Not intimidated, Grizzy and the Lemmings decide to get their hands on it, but the entire bird colony intervenes.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings open a nightclub with blasting music and a disco ball in an igloo they have built not far from the cabin. The noise prevents Grizzy from sleeping. The bear confiscates the disco ball and propels the Lemmings far into the distance. They land in an ice cave where they discover a console that lights up the stars in the sky and controls the northern lights. The canopy of heaven starts blinking. The Lemmings transform the ice field into an open-air discotheque!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings have set up a long line of dominos in the cabin that ends with several giant ice blocks and a rocket outside. / The Lemmings find an ice block outside the log cabin that holds a frozen prehistoric animal: a saber-toothed racoon. / By chance, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a container filled with metal survival food flasks. / In a trunk, Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a big chocolate egg with a surprise inside. / The Lemmings open a nightclub. / The Lemmings come up with a ride worthy of a county fair in the living room. / Before an audience of penguins and walruses, two teams of Lemmings perform acrobatic high jumps, competing for the winning prize. / The she-bear Grizzy is enamored with has lost her favorite flower in an inaccessible spot under a giant boulder. Grizzy tries to lift it: impossible! / While Grizzy fishes, a penguin comes over and sees that the bear's bucket is empty. He decides to help him and catches piles of fish.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Before an audience of penguins and walruses, two teams of Lemmings perform acrobatic high jumps, competing for the winning prize. When Grizzy accidentally jumps in, he quickly gets caught up in the game and the clapometer goes wild! Intoxicated by his victory, the bear is by no means a modest winner! But the Lemmings want their moment of glory in the limelight as well!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: While Grizzy fishes, a penguin comes over and sees that the bear's bucket is empty. He decides to help him and catches piles of fish. Impressed, the bear brings the penguin back to the cabin, where a friendship rapidly strikes up. This pleasant and friendly new companion quickly arouses the Lemmings' curiosity. They lure the penguin away on the sly and replace him with another one who's not nearly as clever. Grizzy will quickly see through the trickery.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean wants to take a photo of a rare bird, the Rosy Starling, hoping to win a cash prize from a nature magazine. But the special nuts he’s bought to lure the bird have instead attracted a couple of persistent squirrels, who keep hopping onto the bird table he’s installed and helping themselves to the tasty nuts. It’s Bean vs squirrels, or so he thinks…

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean buys himself a DIY remote-controlled boat kit so he can compete in a race on the local pond. But just as he’s about to finish it, Scrapper sniffs out some nearby sandwiches and causes havoc. In the confusion, Mr Bean thinks the cat has swallowed the rudder of his toy boat, so has to capture him and take him to the vet. Will he get his rudder back in time for the race?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are at the cinema to see the three hour long “Romance In Paris”, which Mr Bean is not looking forward to. But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie – Zombie Aliens 3 – he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: When a TV show offers cash to film in haunted homes, Mr Bean invites a film crew over and rigs his flat up to make it as spooky as possible – wobbly picture frames on wires, eerie noises on a tape recorder and a good old-fashioned sheet for a ghost. But will the tricks be convincing enough to win Mr Bean the money?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean offers to repair Mrs Wicket’s antique necklace, but when his back is turned Scrapper gets entangled and runs off with it around his neck. Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Mr. Bean - The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit notice that Mushpie seems in great shape lately. They want to feel as great as she does and try to discover her secret. When they realise that she works out every morning, our friends decide to join her. And soon, all the Mushables do too. Now Lilit notices that Mushpie doesn’t seem in such great shape anymore…

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables
programme.desc: When Chep asks Mush-Mush and Lilit to go storm-watching and they refuse, Lilit feels bad and convinces Mush-Mush to join their friend. But there are no storms on the horizon. When they notice Chanterelle going through the forest mysteriously, our Mushlers decide to find out what she’s up to instead. That’s when a big storm starts brewing on the horizon...

programme.title: DW News Africa

The geologically alive planet has many secrets hiding below, too -- a warm internal ocean of liquid water that could nurture life nearly four-billion miles from the sun.

programme.desc: Akadeemik, eesti põlevkivikeemia üks rajajaid, Tallinna Tehnikaülikooli rektor Paul Kogerman jõudis oma ligi 60 eluaasta ajal olla ka haridusminister, õpikute autor, mitme teadusseltsi aktiivne liige. Ta sai tunda nii edu ja tunnustust kui ka laimu ning ebaõiglast tagakiusamist.

programme.title: Eesti lood
programme.desc: Venemaa täiemahuline sissetung Ukrainasse põhjustas suurima sundrände pärast II maailmasõda Euroopas. Tihti räägitakse meedias just täiskasvanutest, kes asuvad elama uude riiki. Film juhib tähelepanu sageli nähtamatutele sõjaohvritele - lastele ja nende toimetuleku mehhanismidele. Filmi keskmes on kaks last, Maša (11) ja Saša (12), kes on sõjapõgenikud Ukrainast.

programme.title: Osoon
programme.desc: Euroopa suuruselt neljanda järve tegeliku ulatuse ning selle lähiümbruse loodusliku ja kultuurilise rikkuse tajumiseks võtavad saatejuhid ette teekonna läbi viie Eesti maakonna. Kristo sõidab jalgrattal Ida-Virumaalt mööda järve kallast lõuna poole. Sander kasutab Võrumaalt põhja poole liikumiseks erinevaid veesõidukeid.

programme.title: Salme: Ancient Viking Burial Ships
programme.desc: Reisime tagasi enam kui tuhande aasta tagusesse Euroopasse, et avastada, mida tähendas viikingiajal viikingiks olemine, ja uurime viimase aja ühte huvitavaimat arheoloogilist leidu.

programme.title: Rännud Kersnaga
programme.desc: Vahur Kersna uurib Sansibaril, miks maailma popmuusika läbi aegade üks säravamaid ikoone sealt 8-aastasena lahkudes enam kunagi sünnisaarele ei naasnud. Vahur kõnnib mööda Freddie jälgi Montereauxis, kus Londoni udude ja paparatsode eest peitudes veetis Mercury sisuliselt oma elu traagilised, kuid uskumatult töised lõpuaastad.

programme.title: Teemaõhtu
programme.desc: Saate Prillitoos külaliseks on Kaja Kärner. Täna on Kaja Kärneri 73. sünnipäev. Palju õnne!

programme.title: Mehed, hakkame elama!
programme.desc: Erisaade keskendub liikumisele. Kuidas motiveerida end iga ilmaga välja minema? Oma kogemusi kehalise aktiivsuse olulisusest meie vaimsele ja füüsilisele tervisele jagavad Robert Linna, Väino Laisaar, Kalju Koch ja Rauno Märks. Erki Nool näitab harjutusi, kuidas iga ilmaga ja igal pool saab õues trenni teha.

programme.title: Maahommik
programme.desc: Maahommik rändab mööda Eestimaad ringi ja kohtub erinevate inimeste ja nende põnevate tegemistega. Teie ees rullub lahti maaelu värvipalett koos kõikide oma varjunditega. Loomad, taimed, talud, tööd ja musttuhat muud lugu ootab teid just Maahommiku saates. Saatejuht Maili Metssalu, režissöör Mikk Mäe, produtsent Tiina-Mari Koljak.

programme.title: Maitserännak Eestimaal
programme.desc: Peakokk Roman Zaštšerinski läheb varavalges koos Hiiumaa kaluritega merele, et püüda värsket lesta. Hiiumaale lendab ka peakokk Nikita Tšunihhin, et aidata Romanil püütud kalast miskit maitsvat valmistada. Privaatkokk Jana Guzanova külastab Eesti seenepealinnaks kutsutavat Tõrva linna, kus tegutseb Põhjamaade suurim seenekasvandus. Ja muidugi näitab ta meile, mida maitsvat nendest seentest teha saab.

programme.title: Pealtnägija
programme.desc: Pealtnägija on Eesti pikima ajalooga ja teletabelite tipus olev uuriv ajakirjandussaade, mis toob vaatajateni põnevad ja paljastavad lood meie ühiskonna telgitagustest. Lisaks teravatele uurimustele vahendab saade ka haaravaid persoone ja meeldejäävaid reportaaže sündmustest, mille pealtnägijaks tavaline inimene naljalt ei satu. Saatejuht Mihkel Kärmas, kaasautorid Kristjan Pihl, Reimo Sildvee, Margit Kilumets, Heliis Raudik ja Uljana Kuzmina. Režissöörid Vladlen Pobjaržin ja Märten Vaher, produtsent Piret Priisaar.

programme.title: Lennud
programme.desc: Oleme jõudnud XII lennuni, kelle õppeaastateks olid 1982-1986. Diplomilavastused - Loomaaialugu, Mees on mees, Lika, Ferdinand Vahva ja Lõõmav pimedus. Kooliaega meenutavad Liina Tennosaar, Aita Vaher, Toomas Taimla, Peeter Tammearu ja Peeter Oja.

programme.title: Kuus vaadet disainile
programme.desc: Kuus Eesti disainerit näitavad, kui erinev võib olla ühe graafilise disaineri töö: plakatitest ja pakenditest, tossudest ja plaadiümbristest kirjatüüpide loomiseni. Raamatute köitmisest, õpetamise ja kirjastamiseni. Lisaks avame, kuidas üks Amsterdami kunstikool on aidanud avardada terve põlvkonna arusaama graafilisest disainist ja kuidas see kõik on ka Eesti disainiõpet muutnud. Saade on valminud koostöös ETDMga. Saatejuht Johannes Tralla, idee autor Sandra Nuut-Biasin, režissöör Märten Vaher, toimetaja Heleri All, produtsent Kädi Rammula.

programme.title: Maryland
programme.desc: Lugu kahest erineva elusaatusega õest, kes pärast ema ootamatut surma leiavad taas tee teineteiseni. 1. osa. Õed Becca ja Rosaline saavad ootamatu teate ema surmast. Nende üllatuseks leitakse ema aga hoopiski Mani saarelt, mitte Walesist, kus ta lähedaste teada viibis. Becca ja Rosaline sõidavad kohale, et salapärast lugu uurida.

programme.title: Scotland - The New Wild
programme.desc: Mägismaa on maastik, kus domineerivad künkad, metsad ja kuristikud; see on koht, mida inimesed ja kliima on tugevasti muutnud, kuid see on siiski koduks mõnedele Šotimaa ikoonilisematele liikidele.

programme.title: Poirot
programme.desc: Seekord lasub Poirot'l eriti ränk vastutus, kuna tema hallidest ajurakkudest oleneb, kas röövitud peaminister õnnestub päästa.

programme.title: Poirot
programme.desc: Filmitäht kavatseb kanda peol oma kuulsat teemanti, mida on temalt kirja teel tagasi nõutud. Enne pidu aga varastatakse nii peoperenaine kui ka tema teemant.

programme.title: Uus arhitektuur
programme.desc: Sedakorda keskendutakse kultuuripärandile - objektideks on mälestised, muinsusmajad, muinsuskaitsealale jäävad hooned, tööstus- ja militaarpärand jne. Teine teema, millega tuleb järjest rohkem arvestada, on kliimast tingitud muutused ehk kuidas renoveerida vanu ja ehitada uusi hooneid nii, et neid kliimakahjude eest kaitsta. Aga mida tähendab mõiste „uus arhitektuur“?

programme.title: Õhinapõhised Kuubal
programme.desc: Havanna laguneb, krigiseb ja tossab. Aga samas ka pulseerib, tantsib ja heliseb nagu ei ükski teine linn maailmas. Tõeline vabaõhuteater elab harukordse kirega ning tema suurim vaatamisväärsus on ikkagi tänav, Havanna igapäevaelu sürreaalne ja sõnades kirjeldamatu kompott, „vaese mehe kabaree“.

programme.title: Aktuaalne kaamera
programme.desc: Aktuaalne kaamera on pikima ajalooga teleuudiste saade Eestis. Aktuaalse kaamera põhisaade jõuab vaatajateni ETV ja ETV2 kanalil igal õhtul kell 21:00.

programme.title: Ühe pere muusika
programme.desc: Kalju Terasmaa on üks vähestest Eesti artistidest, kes saanud oma nimelise lava - Kalju lava. Ühest küljest on see meenutuseks tema kullafondi lauldud lauludest nagu näiteks Halloo kosmos, halloo maa! ja vibrafonisoolodest, teisalt on tema järeltulijad kõik andekad muusikud, kes tema talenti edasi kannavad.

programme.title: Meie hõimlased
programme.desc: Meie hõimlased on taas rännakul soome-ugri rahvaste juurde. Seekord teeme pikema tiiru saamide juures, kus harjutame põhjapõdra püüdmist ning saame osa sajandite pikkusest traditsioonist.

programme.title: Ainulaadne aastakäik
programme.desc: Põnev mälumäng toob veelkord ekraanile 1953. aasta põlvkonna teadmised ja karjääri - mängulaudade taga on armastatud muusikud - helilooja ja pianist Rein Rannap, Hortus Musicuse looja Andres Mustonen ning koorijuht Urve Uusberg. Nooremat põlvkonda esindavad dirigent ja helilooja Rasmus Puur ning lauljad Maria Listra ja Maarja-Liis Ilus. Seekord kõlab Rein Rannapi looming Rahvusmeeskoori esituses, juhatab Mikk Üleoja. Mängu juhib Margus Saar, toimetajad on Anne-Mari Müller, Karmel Killandi ja Margit Kilumets. Produtsent Kadi Priske.

programme.desc: Aktuaalne kaamera on Eesti Televisiooni igapäevane eestikeelne uudistesaade.

programme.desc: Sport. Sport

programme.title: Baltimaade ooperigala
programme.desc: Esmakordselt toimuv Baltimaade ooperigala toob kokku Eesti, Läti ja Leedu rahvusooperi solistid. Nendega koos astuvad lavale Rahvusooper Estonia orkester ja koor Arvo Volmeri juhatusel. Kolme riigi ooperimajade koostöös sündinud galast saab iga-aastane sündmus, mis toimub edaspidi vaheldumisi Eestis, Lätis ja Leedus.

programme.title: Sherlock
programme.desc: Sherlock on tagasi kolmes uues seikluses, mis pakuvad naeru, pisaraid, vapustusi, üllatusi ja erakordseid juhtumeid. Sherlock naaseb Inglismaa pinnale just hetkel, kui doktor Watson ja Mary valmistuvad lapse sünniks. Neljanda hooaja avaosas otsib Sherlock, kus võiks aset leida Moriarty rünnak teisest ilmast. Scotland Yardil on küll käsil segane juhtum, kuid Sherlockit vaevab hoopis üks pealtnäha tühine asjaolu.

programme.title: Soovide puu
programme.desc: Noor maatüdruk Liina tahab alustada iseseisvat elu. Lootes linnas paremaid võimalusi leida, sõidab ta Tallinna oma sugulase Ave juurde. Võõras linnas kohtub Liina erinevate mikromaailmadega, mille asukateks on rohkem või vähem kentsakad inimesed meie ümber. Nad kõik soovivad midagi ja on kuhugi teel. Nende soovide ja reaalsuse kokkupõrkel tekib absurdimaigulisi ja kurbnaljakaid olukordi. Kohanemisraskustega maadeldes leiab Liina lõpuks selle, mis aitab tal edasi minna, selle, mida ta tegelikult otsima tuli - iseenda. Visuaalselt elamusrikas must komöödia kirjeldab kergelt karikatuurses võtmes meid igapäevaselt ümbritsevaid inimesi ja tänapäevaelu situatsioone, pakkudes mõnusat äratundmisrõõmu nii noorele kui ka vanemale generatsioonile. Osades Elina Pähklimägi, Marilyn Jurman, Ago Soots, Erki Laur, Andres Tabun, Elina Reinold, Margus Grosnõi, Anneli Rahkema, Raimo Pass, Robert Šimuk jpt. Režissöör Liina Paakspuu, operaator Mait Mäekivi, stsenarist Martin Algus, produtsent Karin Reinberg-Šestakov. Tootja Revolver Fim.

programme.title: Film Filmist. Soovide puu - üks film, mitu lugu
programme.desc: Film Soovide puu räägib tänapäevase stiliseeritud, kohati karmi ja läbinisti koomilise loo maatüdrukust, kes linna õnne otsima tuleb. Otsinguks kujuneb iga mängufilmi tegemine alati ka selle tegijatele - režissöörile, operaatorile, näitlejatele ja paljudele teistele. Sarnaselt filmiloo tegelastele on ka neil kõigil oma asi ajada ja oma soov täide viia. Dokumentaalfilm toobki vaatajani nii filmitegijate endi lood võtteplatsilt kui ka mõned salasoovid. Seda kõike stiliseeritud ja koomilises võtmes. Autor Aleksandr Kheyfets.

programme.desc: Publiku ette tulevad inimesed, kes põhilise osa oma elust teesklevad, et on keegi teine. Sel õhtul mängivad nad iseennast. Kohtumised olid pühendatud Tallinna Linnateatri 50. juubelile, kaasates kõiki teatri näitlejaid. Selles saates astub üles näitleja, lavastaja ja Tallinna Linnateatri peanäitejuht Elmo Nüganen. Saatejuhid Henrik Kalmet ja Veiko Tubin, dramaturg Paavo Piik.

programme.title: Hapud Kurgid 2026
programme.desc: Hapukurgihooaeg tuli sel aastal teisiti. Poliitikakatel podises vahetpidamata ja juureldi selle üle, kellest saab Eesti president, kas meil on püsiv valitsus ning kuidas tulla toime rändesurvega. Kooliaasta alguses pakume vaatajatele omamoodi uudistespikrit, mis aitab toimunust sotti saada. Saates analüüsime koos asjatundjatega selle suve kõige olulisemaid uudisteemasid, millel on mõju ka algavale sügishooajale. Saatejuht Taavi Eilat. Režissöör Vladlen Pobjaržin, produtsent Tiina-Mari Koljak.

programme.title: Saba ja sarvedega Laos
programme.desc: Sarja esimeses osas jõutakse Tai pealinna Bangkokki ning asutakse sealse elu, olu ja maitsetega tutvuma. Seda peamiselt selleks, et osata sihtriigi Laose eripärasid paremini mõista ja hinnata. Käiakse kuulsa pilvelõhkuja veelgi kuulsamas katusebaaris, veedetakse aega tuledest ja sagimisest pungil Hiinalinnas, maitstakse Tai sööke ning jõutakse õhtuks kohalikku „Telliskivisse“, kuhu on end maitsete ja helide keskele sisse sättinud kaks Laose kunagiste kuninglike perekondade järeltulijat.

programme.desc: On Kemblefordi lahingu 500. aastapäev, mida tähistatakse mängulahinguga, mille käigus pannakse toime mõrv. Isa Brown alustab uurimist.

programme.desc: Ukraina stuudio võtab kokku Venemaa-Ukraina sõja viimased arengud. Stuudios astuvad koos saatejuhtidega üles eksperdid.

programme.title: Färdkost för föräldrar
programme.desc: Ett tillräckligt bra föräldraskap. Ett barn behöver bli sett och accepterat. Interaktionen mellan barn och förälder påverkar hjärnans utveckling och ger en grundtrygghet. Men vår egen historia kan påverka oss djupt som föräldrar.

programme.title: Trons grunder med Åke Carlson
programme.desc: Tjänsten inför Gud. Som troende är vi smorda att vara konungsliga präster, till att utöva andlig auktoritet och tala uppbyggelse och tröst. Jesus är översteprästen som för vår talan inför Gud. Åke Carlson undervisar.

programme.title: TV7 Israelnyheter
programme.desc: 1) Netanjahu är övertygad om att man kan undanröja hotet från Iranregimen.2) IDF slutför en komplex operation för att rensa Ali al-Taher-åsen.3) Förhandlingar mellan USA och Iran är inte aktuella.

programme.title: Från exodus till idag
programme.desc: Striderna om det Heliga landet fortsätter. Efter korstågstiden dök många nya erövrare upp i det Heliga landet. Snart tog det Osmanska riket över. I Europa utsattes judarna för många tragiska händelser som kan kopplas till en viss kalenderdag.

programme.title: Följa Jesus
programme.desc: Kraft från höjden. Är Jesus din Herre bor Hans Ande i dig och ger dig vilja, kunskap och förmåga att följa Jesus. Men Anden ger också kraft att förmedla helande, befrielse och upprättelse till andra. Med Olof Edsinger.

programme.title: Närmare Gud
programme.desc: Kraften i Guds Ord. Den vishet kung Salomo fick av Gud i gåva finns också hos Jesus. Det var detta som fick Shawn Musick övertygad om att Jesus är den Han utger sig för att vara.

programme.title: Skam- och sårbarhetspodden
programme.desc: Vad är sunda gränser?. Vad är en gräns? Hur vet man vad man har för gränser och hur ska man upprätthålla sunda gränser? Vad beror problem med tvångstankar på?

programme.title: Kristen på jobbet
programme.desc: Samhällspåverkare Sari Essayah. Sari har upplevt Guds hjälp i sitt arbete som politiker. I synnerhet som hon känner att hon är på rätt plats och gör det jobb som Gud förberett för henne.

programme.title: Israel talar
programme.desc: De historiska byggnadernas berättelser. Jerusalem bjuder på tusentals berättelser. Vi lyssnar till vad tre vackra och ännu viktiga byggnader berättar: Christ Church, hotell King David och hotell American Colony – med koppling till Sverige.

programme.title: Det är övernaturligt!
programme.desc: Gäst Erick Stakelbeck. Hemliga dokument avslöjar Muslimska brödraskapets plan på att gömma sig bakom en respektabel fasad men samtidigt systematiskt arbeta för att krossa Amerika och Europa inifrån i ett osynligt jihad.

programme.title: Bibliska nycklar till helande
programme.desc: Fanns sexualiteten innan syndafallet?. I Bibelns första två kapitel läser vi om hur det var att leva på jorden innan syndafallet. Allt var gott. Fanns sexualiteten redan i Edens lustgård, eller uppkom den som ett resultat av syndafallet?

programme.title: LUMO - Johannesevangeliet
programme.desc: Johannes 7:45-8:30. Dramatisering av evangelietexten på svenska. Jesus och äktenskapsbryterskan. Jesus är världens ljus.

programme.title: Café Bibeln Uppsala
programme.desc: Med Kristus i centrum. Utan Gamla Testamentet skulle vi inte förstå Nya Testamentet. Jesus själv hänvisade gång på gång till att Skrifterna talade om Honom! Bo-Krister Ljungberg och Leif Nummela talar om Kristusteman i GT.

programme.title: Pilgrim Media
programme.desc: Dela med dig eller snåla. Vad har Gud gjort för dig, och varför gjorde han det? Vi kan lätt bli snåla med allt Gud ger oss varje dag. Andy And Eva Shefford delar om att det behövs en revolution inom kristenheten.

programme.title: Färdkost för föräldrar
programme.desc: Ett tillräckligt bra föräldraskap. Ett barn behöver bli sett och accepterat. Interaktionen mellan barn och förälder påverkar hjärnans utveckling och ger en grundtrygghet. Men vår egen historia kan påverka oss djupt som föräldrar.

programme.title: Trons grunder med Åke Carlson
programme.desc: Tjänsten inför Gud. Som troende är vi smorda att vara konungsliga präster, till att utöva andlig auktoritet och tala uppbyggelse och tröst. Jesus är översteprästen som för vår talan inför Gud. Åke Carlson undervisar.

programme.title: TV7 Israelnyheter
programme.desc: 1) Netanjahu är övertygad om att man kan undanröja hotet från Iranregimen.2) IDF slutför en komplex operation för att rensa Ali al-Taher-åsen.3) Förhandlingar mellan USA och Iran är inte aktuella.

programme.title: Från exodus till idag
programme.desc: Striderna om det Heliga landet fortsätter. Efter korstågstiden dök många nya erövrare upp i det Heliga landet. Snart tog det Osmanska riket över. I Europa utsattes judarna för många tragiska händelser som kan kopplas till en viss kalenderdag.

programme.title: Följa Jesus
programme.desc: Kraft från höjden. Är Jesus din Herre bor Hans Ande i dig och ger dig vilja, kunskap och förmåga att följa Jesus. Men Anden ger också kraft att förmedla helande, befrielse och upprättelse till andra. Med Olof Edsinger.

programme.title: Närmare Gud
programme.desc: Kraften i Guds Ord. Den vishet kung Salomo fick av Gud i gåva finns också hos Jesus. Det var detta som fick Shawn Musick övertygad om att Jesus är den Han utger sig för att vara.

programme.title: Skam- och sårbarhetspodden
programme.desc: Vad är sunda gränser?. Vad är en gräns? Hur vet man vad man har för gränser och hur ska man upprätthålla sunda gränser? Vad beror problem med tvångstankar på?

programme.title: Kristen på jobbet
programme.desc: Samhällspåverkare Sari Essayah. Sari har upplevt Guds hjälp i sitt arbete som politiker. I synnerhet som hon känner att hon är på rätt plats och gör det jobb som Gud förberett för henne.

programme.title: Israel talar
programme.desc: De historiska byggnadernas berättelser. Jerusalem bjuder på tusentals berättelser. Vi lyssnar till vad tre vackra och ännu viktiga byggnader berättar: Christ Church, hotell King David och hotell American Colony – med koppling till Sverige.

programme.title: Det är övernaturligt!
programme.desc: Gäst Erick Stakelbeck. Hemliga dokument avslöjar Muslimska brödraskapets plan på att gömma sig bakom en respektabel fasad men samtidigt systematiskt arbeta för att krossa Amerika och Europa inifrån i ett osynligt jihad.

programme.title: Bibliska nycklar till helande
programme.desc: Fanns sexualiteten innan syndafallet?. I Bibelns första två kapitel läser vi om hur det var att leva på jorden innan syndafallet. Allt var gott. Fanns sexualiteten redan i Edens lustgård, eller uppkom den som ett resultat av syndafallet?

programme.title: Bugtime Adventures
programme.desc: Stolthet går före fall. Berättelsen om Naaman och Elisa.

programme.title: Rötter och reflektioner
programme.desc: Arkeologiska skatter. Barry besöker fascinerande utgrävningar från Elias tid och kung Jehus tid samt mackabeernas gravplats.

programme.title: Uppenbarelseboken med Niclas Ljung
programme.desc: Introduktion till Uppenbarelseboken. Det myllrar av perspektiv och detaljer i Uppenbarelseboken men här pekar Niclas Ljung på bokens övergripande syfte: att påminna troende om Guds omsorg, trofasthet och makt - även i tider av lidande.

programme.title: LUMO - Lukasevangeliet
programme.desc: Lukas 24:1-56. Dramatisering av evangelietexten på svenska. Jesus uppstår ur graven och visar sig för Emmausvandrarna. Jesus visar sig för lärjungarna. Jesu himmelsfärd.

programme.title: Guds syfte med familjen
programme.desc: Familjen - en återspegling av Gud själv. Paulo Fillion undervisar om hur familjen reflekterar Guds väsen. Föräldrarna representerar Gud inför sina barn. Familjen har den viktiga uppgiften att forma nästa generations ledare och medborgare.

programme.title: Fika i Uppsala
programme.desc: Till jordens yttersta gräns. ”Jag vill lära känna Jesus djupare, men också göra Honom känd längre bort - från hemmaplan till Långtbortistan.” Mikael Boman brinner för att nå de onådda, och träna andra att också göra det.

programme.title: Välsignelse, förbannelse eller slump? -studieserie
programme.desc: 5/13. Filistéerna. Filistéerna, ett krigiskt folk på Bibelns tid, bekämpade ihärdigt Guds utvalda folk Israel. I dag finns i stort sett inga spår kvar av deras existens. Är detta en slump, eller kan Gud ligga bakom?

programme.title: Bible Project svenska
programme.desc: Lagen. Vilken betydelse och funktion hade lagarna i Gamla Testamentet? Varför finns de i Bibeln, hur passar de in i Bibelns berättelse och vad har de att säga till Jesus efterföljare? Teman i Bibeln 12/14.

programme.title: Bible Project svenska
programme.desc: Messias. Här utforskar vi Bibelns tidiga och mystiska löfte om att en befriare en dag ska komma för att slutgiltigt konfrontera ondskan och rädda mänskligheten. Teman i Bibeln 13/14.

programme.title: Makt med Gud
programme.desc: Kallad att välsigna. Det finns en makt i att välsigna andra.

programme.title: Riken i tiden
programme.desc: Denna fängslande dokumentär tar tittarna med på en resa genom historien och avslöjar bibliska profetior som har förutsagt forntida rikens uppgång och fall med häpnadsväckande exakthet.

programme.title: The Sound of Silence
programme.desc: Konsert och föreläsning med Ruben Agnarsson och Stig Lindell med Europas antisemitism som tema. Vi har Bob Dylans och Paul Simons musikskatt eftersom deras förfäder flydde från Europas judeförföljelser.

programme.title: Upptäck livet
programme.desc: Den glädjefyllda Guden. Vad är den bästa gåva Gud skulle kunna ge dig? Sorg och glädje går ofta hand i hand. Bibeln talar om en fullkomlig glädje efter all bedrövelse - glädjen i Gud själv. Var finner du din glädje?

programme.title: Kristet Center Örebro
programme.desc: Familjegudstjänst – Glädje att tjäna. Familjegudstjänst ledd av Anna Karlsson där vi får ta del av drama, dans, undervisning och sång med både stora och små. Temat denna gång är glädjen i att få hjälpa andra.

programme.title: Rakt på sak med Ingemar Helmner
programme.desc: Vad bär du med dig ut i livet?. Få saker är så glädjande och tillfredsställande som när man får se sin barn, både fysiska och andliga, stiga ut i livet med en frimodig tro på HERREN. Det är en sann belöning av våra förböner.

programme.title: Letters
programme.desc: En uppfylld barndomsdröm. Viktor Junaeus Magnusson drömde som ung om att bli läkare men drömmen gick i kras och självförtroendet gick i botten när hans liv sjönk ner i festande och dåliga betyg.

programme.title: Att höra Guds röst
programme.desc: Vad gör jag nu?. Om jag nu först har lyssnat och sen har prövat det jag hört och kommit fram till att det här är Guds tilltal till mig – vad ska jag göra då? Vad är nästa steg? Med Sven Almkvist och Daniela Persin.

programme.title: Fokus Israel - Löftets folk
programme.desc: En tro som frälser. Hur skiljer sig kristendomen från andra religioner? Det är en stor nåd att veta att man är frälst endast genom tro, och inte genom gärningar. Sven Reichmann undervisar.

programme.title: Gamla Testamentet öppnas
programme.desc: 1 Moseboken. Del 3/6. Skapade varelser och evolutionen. David Pawson undervisar.

programme.title: John Fenn - ABC för husförsamlingar
programme.desc: Hur tar vi hand om barnen?. I en åhörarförsamling delar man upp familjen i olika grupper men i husförsamlingar integrerar man barnen i gudstjänstlivet på olika kreativa sätt. John Fenn delar sina erfarenheter.

programme.title: LUMO - Markusevangeliet
programme.desc: Markus 6:1-56. Dramatisering av evangelietexten på svenska. Jesus förkastas i sin hemstad. Jesus sänder ut de tolv. Johannes döparens död. Jesus mättar fem tusen. Jesus går på vattnet. Jesus botar sjuka i Gennesaret

programme.title: Eld från Jerusalem
programme.desc: Att känna Guds vilja och höra Hans röst. Det viktigaste i en troendes liv är att känna och höra Guds röst. Vi behöver lära oss att sitta vid Jesu fötter och lyssna som Maria och att tro på det Gud säger.

programme.title: Nära till Himlen LIVE
programme.desc: Överlåtet hjärta. GÖTEBORG. Vad händer när ett uppriktigt hjärta överlåter sig helt till Gud? Daniel och Anna Åliden samtalar med Anders och Marie Johansson om helighet, tillbedjan och Guds närvaro.

programme.title: Kungen kommer
programme.desc: Frälsningsplanen i Herrens högtider. Visste du att hela Guds frälsningsplan skrevs in i solen, månen och stjärnorna redan i skapelsen? Att Gud planerade allt i minsta detalj, även Jesu återkomst, redan då? Samtal utifrån 3 Mos 23:1-2.

programme.title: Varvet
programme.desc: Jesustejp 2/4. I det ögonblick du kom till tro på Jesus fick du den Helige Ande som ett sigill till tecken på att Gud är ägaren. Anden föder och förstärker tron på Jesus och visar att Gud är en god Far.

programme.title: John Fenn - ABC för husförsamlingar
programme.desc: Hur tar vi hand om barnen?. I en åhörarförsamling delar man upp familjen i olika grupper men i husförsamlingar integrerar man barnen i gudstjänstlivet på olika kreativa sätt. John Fenn delar sina erfarenheter.

programme.title: LUMO - Markusevangeliet
programme.desc: Markus 6:1-56. Dramatisering av evangelietexten på svenska. Jesus förkastas i sin hemstad. Jesus sänder ut de tolv. Johannes döparens död. Jesus mättar fem tusen. Jesus går på vattnet. Jesus botar sjuka i Gennesaret

programme.title: Eld från Jerusalem
programme.desc: Att känna Guds vilja och höra Hans röst. Det viktigaste i en troendes liv är att känna och höra Guds röst. Vi behöver lära oss att sitta vid Jesu fötter och lyssna som Maria och att tro på det Gud säger.

programme.title: Nära till Himlen LIVE
programme.desc: Överlåtet hjärta. GÖTEBORG. Vad händer när ett uppriktigt hjärta överlåter sig helt till Gud? Daniel och Anna Åliden samtalar med Anders och Marie Johansson om helighet, tillbedjan och Guds närvaro.

programme.title: Kungen kommer
programme.desc: Frälsningsplanen i Herrens högtider. Visste du att hela Guds frälsningsplan skrevs in i solen, månen och stjärnorna redan i skapelsen? Att Gud planerade allt i minsta detalj, även Jesu återkomst, redan då? Samtal utifrån 3 Mos 23:1-2.

programme.title: The Hunt for Baltic Gold
programme.desc: Myrsky on tulossa. Tomekilla on kiire varusteidensa kanssa. Herkules lähtee juhlimaan klubille. Krzysztof ottaa uuden jäsenen, Bartekin, ryhmään. Dorota neuvottelee raa’an meripihkan hinnasta. Formellasit seilaavat merelle hakemaan kalaverkkoja.

programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot
programme.desc: Kunnioitus numeroa kolme kohtaan juontaa juurensa tuhansien vuosien takaa, ja sitä esiintyy nykyäänkin taiteessa, arkkitehtuurissa, tieteessä, kirjallisuudessa ja uskonnossa. Mikä kyseisessä numerossa yhä edelleen kiehtoo ihmisiä?

programme.title: Grant
programme.desc: Ulysses S. Grant ottaa voiton Robert E. Leestä ja koko sisällissodasta, mutta huomaa, että hänen halutaan palvelevan presidenttinä yhtenä Yhdysvaltain historian vaikeimmista ajoista.

programme.title: Food Tech
programme.desc: Bobby Bognar tutkii italialaista keittiötä pitkin Yhdysvaltoja hakien aineksia, selvittäen New Yorkissa pastan saloja ja etikoiden ja viinien saloja Kaliforniassa sekä jälkiruokien saloja aina New Jerseystä Costa Ricaan.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: Jäljitettyään Hitlerin yrityksiä palata valtaan Argentiinan ja Brasilian varakkaiden tukijoiden kautta Bob Baer ja tohtori John Cencich lähtivät Etelä-Amerikkaan selvittämään tähän mennessä suurinta johtolankaansa.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Tervetuloa kierrokselle galaktiseen taidegalleriaan! Näyttelyssä on mukana taivaiden kruununjalokivet, nebulat. Nebula eli tähtisumu on salaperäinen kaasupilvi, jota ei luokitella tähdeksi, planeetaksi kuuksi tai asteroidiksi.

programme.title: Lost Relics of The Knights Templar
programme.desc: Natsiaarteet. Roomalaiset kolikot. Viikinkiesineet. Espanjalainen kulta. Nämä ovat joitain mittaamattoman arvokkaista aarteista, joita arvostetut, mutta tuntemattomat, aarteenmetsästäjät Hamilton White ja Carl Cookson pääsevät käsittelemään.

programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot
programme.desc: Merimiehet ovat kertoneet tarinoita kadonneista ja salaperäisistä saarista, kehittyneistä sivilisaatioista ja paratiiseista läpi historian. Voivatko tarinat olla jotain muutakin kuin kekseliäiden merenkävijoiden juttuja?

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: Kansainvälisessä ufopaikassa Lue Elizondo näkee ainutlaatuisen videon hehkuvasta pallosta. Sen on jokin aika sitten kuvannut lentäjä 10 000 metrissä. Elizondo tutkii mahdollisia salaisen teknologian kytköksiä Neuvostoliittoon liittyen.

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: Ryhmä suuntaa ufoihin ja armeijaan liittyvien salaliittojen keskukseen eli Alue 51:een. He kuulustelevat oletetun avaruusaluksen säilytyspaikan entisiä työntekijöitä.

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: Tutustu salaperäisiin ja tuntemattomiin asioihin Kansasin Delphosista New Mexicon Roswelliin ja tapaa niitä, jotka väittävät nähneensä ufoja tai jopa joutuneensa avaruusolentojen sieppaamiksi. Onko totuus siellä jossain?
